A garage in Alethriko

K&G Stylianou Garage works at St Epiphaniou 21 in Alethriko, in the Larnaca district. Its sign names car service, a diagnostic centre, A/C gas refilling and tyre services. Customers include private drivers and a car rental company that trusts the garage with its fleet. The owner answers almost every Google review.
